messages:
Sam L: Heads up — we need a compact visual package for the upcoming webinar + launch posts. Two deliverables: 1) Inbound webinar flow diagram (how leads move from ad > webinar > demo booking) as an annotated, exportable PNG/SVG. 2) A set of 3 micro-benchmark cards (desktop hero + mobile tile + story) that show latency vs cost tradeoffs for Redwood. Deadline: Tue EOD (48h). Can design take?
Marco D: on it. quick q: for the webinar flow, do you want an operational wiring diagram (systems + events) or a marketing-facing journey map?
Sam L: Marketing-facing journey map please — simple lanes for Ad, Landing, Webinar, Follow-up (email/seq), Demo booking. Callouts for conversion points and lead scoring. Keep it non-technical.
Elaine (Growth): Also include 2 CTAs in the flow: "Register" and "Book a demo". For the cards: use the short copy below, keep to brand colors, and we need alt text for accessibility. I'll paste the copy: - Card A headline: "13–50ms median latency — lower cost per token" - Card B headline: "Scale-friendly batching saves 2–4x on tokens" - Card C headline: "Fall back policies keep SLAs during spikes"
Elaine (Growth): sizing: desktop hero 1200x628, mobile tile 1080x1080, story 1080x1350. SVG preferred for diagrams.
Marco D: cool. Nora — quick brand check: can I use the new gradient for hero backgrounds or stick to solid?
Nora (Brand): Stick to solid for benchmarks (contrast + accessibility). You can use gradient for the webinar hero only if contrast ratios are 4.5:1 for body text. Also avoid the neon accent in small tiles — it breaks on dark mode.
Marco D: noted. For the lead routing matrix, do you want icons for systems (SFDC, HubSpot) or generic shapes?
Sam L: generic shapes + small label (e.g., "CRM") — don't call out vendors. We want product-agnostic ops view for customers.
DesignOps: FYI — attaching standard export presets and the Figma skeleton for microbench tiles: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/webinar-microbench-skeleton (ask for edit link if you need it).
Figma Bot: Marco D opened the file: webinar-microbench-skeleton — node 42.
Marco D: uploading first pass in ~6h. Plan: 1) flow diagram (SVG) with 3 variants: full-page, cropped social, and one-slide PNG. 2) 3 bench tiles with two color variants (light/dark).
Elaine (Growth): can we include a one-line metric overlay on each card (e.g., "0.7¢/k token") — we'll fill numbers in final copy. Keep space for it.
Marco D: yes. I’ll leave a token-metric slot top-right.
Nora (Brand): also add a small brand-lockup area with enough clearspace. Use the approved logotype file (v2).
Sam L: tagging priority — Marco, please put 'needs legal review' flag if anything claims specific numbers. Elaine will confirm numeric claims tomorrow morning.
Marco D: understood. I'll mark placeholder numbers as "TBD" and add a comment for legal.
Elaine (Growth): small ask — can one of the microtiles be optimized for dark backgrounds? We sometimes use in-feed dark ads.
Marco D: will do. Dark-mode variant with inverted copy color + solid card background.
DesignOps: export checklist: - SVG diagram (optimized) - PNG 1200x628 hero - PNG 1080x1080 tile (light + dark) - PNG 1080x1350 story - Alt text file (CSV) with 3 rows - Figma comments addressed
Marco D: timeline: first pass uploads in 6h, updated pass after Elaine's copy + Nora's signoff. If legal flags numbers, we may need another round (add 24h).
Sam L: thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. Elaine & Nora, please drop final approved copy and any legal constraints ASAP so Marco can iterate. :pray:
Elaine (Growth): I'll drop final copy by 11am PT tomorrow.
Nora (Brand): I'll review gradients + logotype now and post one comment.
Marco D: great — will circle back after first pass. :thumbsup:
